name: Moémon Quetzal
summary: Moémon Quetzal is a ROM hack of Pokémon Emerald on the Game Boy Advance, featuring local and online co-op, a cast of Pokémon from Generations 1 to 9 with battle gimmicks from across the series, overworld wild encounters, and built-in modifications settings and cheats. It differs from Pokémon Quetzal in that the Pokémon have been replaced with anthropomorphic "moé" characters, like that of other Moémon titles.
